body: Genezio has no fixed tiers and no per-seat pricing. Each plan is scoped around four levers: the answer engines you track, the markets and languages you cover, the personas, topics and scenarios you monitor, and your monthly conversation volume.
Every engagement starts with a demo, after which the team prepares a quote for your footprint.
Plans can grow or shrink later. Engines, markets, personas, brands and volume can be added, or reduced between cycles, through your account manager.
